name: Darnell Vance
psychographics: Pragmatic; believes time is as valuable as money and shops for the best combo of both
current_solutions: Uses Facebook Marketplace for kids' gear; buys gas at the county station with the loyalty card; streams Netflix on the family TV
frustration: Tried to order a specific brand of infant formula at 11 PM via the store app; the checkout kept erroring out with 'payment declined'; had to wake his partner to use her card, wasting 20 minutes before giving up and driving to the 24-hour Walmart
decision_style: Checks local flyers and asks coworkers for recommendations; buys in bulk when he finds a good price on non-perishables
voice: Direct and concise, uses workshop slang like 'job site' and 'stock', gets to the point quickly
